theorem.name: PostAlphaIndependentPrimitiveRowsExecutionOrDynamicDotDTraceBindingImport
theorem.statement: The long-name independent primitive branch imports acceptance of the dynamic dotD/Phi_fin^C1 trace binding. The 72 primitive rows are attempted but remain unexecuted because residual completion or honest Galerkin C1 emission is still required. Conditional A, b, and deltaTheta replay values are retained without promotion.

theorem.name: PostAlphaPrimitiveRowsExecutionOrDynamicDotDTraceBindingImport
theorem.statement: The selected dynamic dotD/Phi_fin^C1 trace binding is accepted from the stationary transported trace, transport-derivative formula, and same-branch alpha1/dotD driver. The 72 primitive rows are attempted against the selected basis and dynamic trace, but no row is executed because the fixed-fiber primitive span has a residual-completion obstruction. Conditional A, b, and deltaTheta replay values are retained only as conditional evidence and are not promoted.
